what_happened.line: The newly seated Finance Committee elected a chair, a vice chair and a clerk, each by unanimous roll call.
The committee appointed one member to the capital planning committee and reappointed him to the building planning committee, by roll call with all ayes heard.
A working group reported on its plan to study town debt scenarios against the town fiscal policy, whose debt limits were described.
The fiscal policy's dollar thresholds were described as set about seven years ago and never adjusted for inflation.
May minutes were tabled to a later agenda, and the next meeting was set for August 13th with committee reports added.

why_it_matters: The debt review bears on how much the town can borrow for future projects, and so on the debt service that tax bills carry, whether inside the levy or through excluded debt voters are asked to approve.
Debt limits set in dollar terms years ago and not adjusted for inflation can bind sooner than intended, which may shape what borrowing reaches a Town Meeting vote.
